hero_subtitle: India’s Trusted Digital & Local News Platform
mission_statement: SeaNeB News was founded with a simple mission to make news more
description: In a world dominated by large media houses, many grassroots stories go unheard. SeaNeB changes that by empowering local journalists, regional reporters, and community contributors to publish directly on our platform.
vision_text: To become India’s most trusted hyperlocal digital news network.
missionPoints: Provide a publishing platform for verified contributors
footer_text: Our editorial team ensures every published story meets quality and factual standards. We are not just a news website, we are a community-driven digital media ecosystem.
